f.title: When FDA requires a REMS modification under section 505-1(g), submit the proposed modification
f.statement: When FDA determines that a REMS modification is necessary to ensure that the benefits of the drug outweigh its risks, to minimize the burden on the health care delivery system of complying with the REMS, or to accommodate different, comparable aspects of the ETASU for an ANDA drug and its applicable listed drug, FDA has the authority under section 505-1(g) of the FD&C Act to require the application holder to submit a proposed REMS modification; the application holder must then submit it.
f.clause: II. Background
f.applicability: Approved REMS (NDA, ANDA and BLA), including shared system REMS

rows.quote:
In addition, when the
FDA determines that a modification of a REMS is necessary to ensure that the benefits of a drug
outweigh its risks, to minimize the burden on the health care delivery system of complying with
the REMS, or to accommodate different, comparable aspects of the elements to assure safe use
(ETASU) for a drug that is the subject of an application under section 505(j), and the applicable
listed drug, the FDA has the authority to require that the application holder submit a proposed
modification to a REMS under section 505-1(g) of the FD&C Act.
rows.location: II. Background
rows.review_note: Review: title: The quote describes FDA's authority ('FDA has the authority to require that the application holder submit'). The holder's duty is to comply once FDA requires the change. The title now names that trigger instead of reading as an unconditional duty. statement: The holder's conditional statutory duty is stated explicitly. Mandatory is kept under the coordinator's rule that statutory duties quoted in the guidance are Mandatory. The 505-1(g)(4)(B) submission deadline is not stated in this text, so no deadline is added. Double-check: quote verbatim, statement within the quote, level follows the modal verb.

f.title: Classify editorial REMS changes that do not affect risk or safe-use information or stakeholder actions as REMS revisions
f.statement: Treat as REMS revisions the editorial changes that do not affect the information in the REMS document and/or REMS materials about the serious risk or safe use of the drug, or the actions that application holders, patients, health care providers or other stakeholders must take to comply with the REMS (or the materials supporting those actions). Revisions are submitted as REMS revisions and summarised in the annual report (examples in Table 1, e.g. holder name or contact changes, editorial and typographical corrections).
f.clause: III.A. REMS Revisions
f.applicability: Approved REMS (NDA, ANDA and BLA), including shared system REMS

rows.quote:
REMS revisions are defined as editorial changes that do not affect:

       •   The information contained in the REMS document and/or REMS materials about the
           serious risk or safe use of the drug

       •   The actions application holders, patients, health care providers, or other stakeholders
           must take to comply with the REMS, or the REMS materials that support those actions

Examples of REMS revisions are provided in Table 1.

Report)

f.title: Treat REMS modifications due to approved or ordered safety labeling changes as major; distinguish conforming changes
f.statement: Modifications to the REMS due to approved safety labeling changes, or to safety labeling changes FDA has directed under section 505(o)(4), are major REMS modifications. Conforming modifications are those that transfer the newly approved labeling language into the existing REMS and/or REMS materials; overall design, programmatic and/or implementation changes resulting from approved or ordered safety labeling changes are not conforming modifications.
f.clause: III.B.2. Major REMS Modifications

rows.quote:
In addition, modifications to the strategy due to approved safety labeling
changes, or to a safety labeling change that the FDA has directed the application holder to make
pursuant to section 505(o)(4) of the FD&C Act, are considered major REMS modifications. The
FDA interprets REMS modifications that conform to safety labeling changes in section 505-
1(h)(2)(A)(iii) of the FD&C Act to refer to modifications that transfer the newly approved
labeling language into the existing REMS and/or REMS materials. Overall design,
programmatic, and/or implementation changes to the REMS that result from approved (or
ordered) safety labeling changes are not considered conforming REMS modifications.

f.statement: The application holder can implement a minor REMS modification 30 days after receipt by FDA, although the changes are not considered final until approved by FDA.

f.legal_basis: 21 CFR 314.70(c); 21 CFR 601.12(c)(3) (CBE-30 implementation 30 days after receipt); FD&C Act 505-1(h)(2)(A)(ii) (FDA 60-day action on minor modifications)

f.exceptions: Implementation should be delayed if FDA informs the application holder, within 14 days of receipt, that information necessary for FDA to act is missing (see 0037). The changes are not final until FDA approves them, and FDA reviews and acts within 60 days of receipt.

f.title: Use the Table A submission identifiers, Form FDA 356h fields, content items, history and rationale for each REMS change type
f.statement: Table A, per type of REMS change: (1) REMS revision: identifier 'REMS REVISION'; Form FDA 356h field 21 'Other' + 'REMS Revision', field 25 'REMS Revision'; items b-h; REMS history recommended; adequate rationale not required. (2) Minor modification: 'NEW SUPPLEMENT FOR [NDA/BLA/ANDA] [assigned #] CHANGES BEING EFFECTED IN 30 DAYS PROPOSED MINOR REMS MODIFICATION'; field 21 'REMS Supplement', 23 'CBE-30', 25 'Proposed Minor REMS Modification'. (3) Major: '... PRIOR APPROVAL SUPPLEMENT PROPOSED MAJOR REMS MODIFICATION'; field 23 'Prior Approval (PA)', 25 'Proposed Major REMS Modification'. (4) Due to safety labeling changes: PAS, '... PROPOSED REMS MODIFICATIONS DUE TO SAFETY LABELING CHANGES SUBMITTED IN SUPPLEMENT [supplement #]', same wording in field 25. (5) Multiple types: PAS or CBE-30; field 23 'PA' or 'CBE-30'; field 25 'Proposed REMS Modification'. (6) Efficacy supplement with modifications (NDA/BLA only): field 21 'Efficacy Supplement' + 'REMS Supplement', 23 'PA', 25 'Efficacy Supplement' + 'Proposed REMS Modification'. (7) CMC supplement with modifications: PAS or CBE-30; field 21 'CMC Supplement' + 'REMS Supplement'; 25 'CMC Supplement' + 'Proposed REMS Modification'. (8) REMS assessment with modifications: PAS or CBE-30; field 21 'REMS Supplement' + 'Other' ('REMS Assessment'); 25 'REMS Assessment' + 'Proposed REMS Modification'. Types 2-8: items b-i, REMS history recommended, adequate rationale required; for type 8 only, the included REMS assessment is considered the adequate rationale.
